verdicts.decision_note: The client identifies the root domain used by customer-facing product links and establishes the requirement that it continue routing to the existing product.
First concrete failure: launching the Webflow site disrupted the root-domain route used by the customer-facing product.
The client confirms the implementation-relevant hosting configuration that an existing non-Webflow host is already connected to the product domain.
The client explicitly requires restoration of the prior DNS record for the root domain, changing the required DNS configuration without invalidating existing routing attributes.
First concrete post-restoration verification: the root domain is reported back up and serving the product normally after its DNS records were restored.
